spec.situation_desc: is asking about branch opening hours
spec.vuln_cue: says they can't afford this, they've got nothing left until payday

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi Liam, could you tell me what time the High Street branch opens tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. The High Street branch opens at half past nine tomorrow and closes at four thirty.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks. I was thinking of popping in to ask about getting a bit of help. I can't afford this, I've got nothing left until payday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry, that sounds really stressful. We can put you in touch with our Financial Support team, and they can talk through options such as extra time to pay.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That would be helpful. I'm not unhappy with the bank or anything, I just need some guidance.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. Just so you know, bank fees can never be refunded, but the team can still explain what support might be available.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Right, okay. Could I speak to someone at the branch tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll contact the High Street branch today and ask them to arrange for someone from Financial Support to call you by 11 tomorrow. I’ll make sure they have your request.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Thanks, Liam. I appreciate you sorting that out.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome. The branch opens at half past nine, and I’ll send that request over today.
